entries.title: Wizordum

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with custom-adventure/editor support.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has native PC settings/capture flexibility and the PC custom-adventure/level-editor community path, while the Mac and console releases do not have platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Wizordum on Steam for Windows PC and play the current 1.0+ build; use the built-in level editor/custom adventures for the broadest post-campaign route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expansion edition is documented.
